column1: # The images `just render` draws from reactor.scad. Columns, tab-separated: name, view, flags.
# view   the camera rotation, as copied from the GUI with Edit > Copy Viewport Rotation.
# flags  -D settings from the reactor.scad Customizer: show (assembly, section, lid), culture_ml,
#        pocket_depth_set, riser_l_set; and any other OpenSCAD option. section removes the -y half,
#        so a front view shows the cut. The section renders with Manifold, which takes about a
#        minute, because a preview draws the cut face of every part in the colour of the last part.
